nodes.title: SG-6.3.1 · Fix App tests for canvas layout and real button names
nodes.body:
Context: in game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx the cases 'Bookshelf menu buttons', 'Search shows hidden door history' and 'remount restores history and Inventory' fail. ObjectOverlay (src/components/ObjectOverlay.tsx L25) returns null when uiStore.canvasLayout is undefined, and the test never sets it. The tests also query buttons named exactly 'Inspect', 'Push', 'Search', 'Leave', while ObjectOverlay labels them '<Action> <Object>' (L63). Desired: tests set a canvas layout and query real accessible names. Why: green App suite, needed for SG-6.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the App in the playing view with a canvas layout in uiStore, when objectClick bookshelf is emitted, then buttons 'Inspect Bookshelf', 'Push Bookshelf', 'Search Bookshelf' and 'Leave Bookshelf' are present.
- Given the Bookshelf menu is open, when 'Search Bookshelf' is clicked, then the hidden door text appears in the story history.
- Given a played game is unmounted and App remounts, then history and the Inventory region are restored.
- ObjectOverlay and GameScreen output is unchanged, no test is deleted or skipped, and all tests in tests/app.test.tsx pass.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx setup and queries
- Out of scope: ObjectOverlay, GameScreen, PhaserHost changes
- Out of scope: other test files
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: ObjectOverlay and GameScreen rendered output
- Preserve: all existing tests


## Technical constraints
- No test deleted or skipped
- Tests mock only what is external
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/frontend
- No source file over 200 lines
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0


## Definition of done
- tests/app.test.tsx passes in full
- typecheck passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Remount test restores history and Inventory with a canvas layout
nodes.body:

- The store is reset between tests so layout state does not leak.

- Out of scope: runtime storage source

nodes.summary: Fix app.test.tsx menu and Search cases with a canvas layout and real names.
nodes.description: Rewrite the two cases in tests/app.test.tsx against real behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Menu case asserts four '<Action> Bookshelf' buttons.
Search case asserts hidden door text.

steps.action: Import useUiStore from '../src/store/uiStore' and beforeEach from vitest; inside describe 'App playing view' add a beforeEach that calls useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true) then useUiStore.getState().setCanvasLayout({ left: 0, top: 0, zoom: 1, dpr: 1 }).
steps.code: beforeEach(() => { useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true); useUiStore.getState().setCanvasLayout({ left: 0, top: 0, zoom: 1, dpr: 1 }); });
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'App playing view'
steps.expected: canvasLayout is set before each case.

steps.symbol: it 'Bookshelf ... Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons appear'
steps.action: Replace names 'Inspect','Push','Search','Leave' with 'Inspect Bookshelf','Push Bookshelf','Search Bookshelf','Leave Bookshelf'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'Inspect, Push'

steps.symbol: it 'Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked'
steps.action: Change the click query name from 'Search' to 'Search Bookshelf'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'Search is clicked'
steps.expected: Hidden door text is in the document.
